en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Sandal from Katheer b. Kathira from Farwa b. al-Ajuri from Abi Ja’far Muhammad b. Ali (a.s.) who said:

Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.), “One who recites Surah Hud every Friday, the Almighty Lord would gather him along with the group of prophets on the Day of Judgment and he would be considered sinless on that day.”
